evals.prompt: 在飞书表格 https://example.feishu.cn/sheets/ShtAbc123 的『销售』子表 D2:D200 里写公式：D = B × C（单价 × 数量），写完要确认结果正确。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Write formulas with +cells-set on the named sheet, then verify with +formula-verify and read back sentinel cells.
expectations: Writes formulas (not static values computed elsewhere) with +cells-set
Passes the sheet with --sheet-name or --sheet-id and keeps --range as A1 notation
Reads back a few sentinel cells (first, middle, last) to confirm the values

evals.prompt: Add a column chart of monthly revenue from A1:B13 on sheet "Summary" of https://example.feishu.cn/sheets/ShtXyz789. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Create one chart with +chart-create-basic, then check it with +chart-list.
expectations: Uses +chart-create-basic for a single basic chart
States the chart type, x-axis field and series before creating it

evals.prompt: 把下面 3 条新订单追加到表格 https://example.feishu.cn/sheets/ShtOrd456 的『订单』子表末尾：订单号 00123、00124、00125，金额分别 120.5、88、240。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Append typed rows with +table-put --mode append, keeping order numbers as text and amounts as numbers.
expectations: Keeps order numbers with leading zeros as text and amounts as numbers
Reads the appended rows back to confirm them

evals.prompt: Delete rows 50 to 60 on sheet "Raw" of https://example.feishu.cn/sheets/ShtRaw001 — the whole rows, not just their contents. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Remove whole rows with +dim-delete rather than clearing cells.
expectations: Uses +dim-delete to delete the whole rows
Does not use +cells-clear as a substitute for deleting rows

evals.prompt: 这个表格 https://example.feishu.cn/sheets/ShtFb002 的 C 列是 1 万多条用户评论，帮我在 D 列给每条评论打上『正面/负面/中性』的情感标签。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Use the native AI formula row by row in column D, then check it with +formula-verify --ai-only over the written range.
expectations: Uses the =AI(prompt, range) formula for the per-row sentiment labels instead of Python-generated static values
Writes the formulas in batches when there are many rows
Checks with +formula-verify --ai-only on the whole written range instead of polling with +cells-get
